subject: Request: walkthrough after Benchmark report download
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@benchmark-analytics.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Downloaded your benchmark — interested in a short demo

Hi Aditya,

I downloaded the Benchmark Analytics report from your site this morning (great write-up). I also used the self-serve demo sign-up and picked a provisional slot, but wanted to follow up directly. A few quick notes on our side: 

- Company: Benchmark Analytics (we analyze user engagement for mid-market e-commerce).
- Primary use case: reduce inference cost for large batch embedding jobs and get predictable latency for real-time scoring.
- Team: ML infra lead + product manager — likely 2 attendees.

Can we do a 30-minute walkthrough next week? I’m in PST (San Francisco). My rough availability: Tue/Wed 11am–2pm PT. If you want more context I can attach our data profile.

Thanks,
Sarah Kim
Director, Platform Insights
Benchmark Analytics

Attachment: benchmark-report.pdf (downloaded from your site)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@benchmark-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 10:03:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Downloaded your benchmark — interested in a short demo

Hi Sarah — great to hear from you and thanks for downloading the report. I’m Aditya on the solutions team — happy to run a focused 30-minute walkthrough and surface the parts of Redwood that map to your use case (batch embeddings cost reduction, predictable scoring latency).

Quick proposal:
- 30 minutes video call (screen share)
- Goals: 1) map your ingest/serving pattern to batching/caching levers, 2) show model/quantization tradeoffs, 3) share a quick cost estimate and next steps.

I’m available:
- Tue 6/17 — 11:30am PT or 1:00pm PT
- Wed 6/18 — 11:00am PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple of times and I’ll shift. Also, if you can share a short data-profile (size of batches, typical sequence lengths, QPS targets) that’ll help me tailor the walkthrough.

I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@benchmark-analytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 08:21:07 -07:00
Subject: Re: Downloaded your benchmark — interested in a short demo

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the quick reply. Wed 6/18 at 11:00am PT works best for us, but one of our PMs will be traveling and may need a slightly later time. Could we tentatively book 11:00am and push to 12:00pm PT if needed? We’ll confirm by end of day Monday.

Also attaching a one-page data-profile (high level) so you can prep — we typically send 500–1,000 embedding requests per minute during peak windows, batch sizes vary between 128–512, and the median sequence length is around 128 tokens.

Cheers,
Sarah

Thanks for the quick update, Sarah — I’ll book Wed 6/18 at 12:00pm PT to allow for the PM’s travel buffer. I’ve attached a calendar invite (aditya_demo_invite.ics) and included a short agenda below. If you confirm 11:00am instead, reply and I’ll move the invite.

Agenda (30 min):
- 5 min intros & goals
- 10 min mapping your profile to caching/batching and model options
- 10 min cost tradeoffs and next steps (POC ask)
- 5 min immediate Qs / follow-ups

Call info: Zoom link (included in invite).

Looking forward to it — I’ll also prep a short example comparing batching strategies given the numbers you shared.

Best,
